title: Who is on the Nvidia Board?
gist: Daniel Nenni lists Nvidia's board of directors after a governance change: Harvey C. Jones (on board since 1993, ex-Synopsys CEO) is now Chair, Stephen Neal is Lead Independent Director, and the board is dominated by long-tenured VC and EDA veterans; non-employee directors earn $363,809/yr versus Jensen Huang's $36.34M FY2026 pay.

insights.claim: Harvey C. Jones, Managing Partner of Square Wave Ventures and former Synopsys CEO and Tensilica co-founder, is Chair of Nvidia's board and has served on it since 1993.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Nvidia's chair is a long-tenured EDA/VC insider, implying continuity rather than an outside governance reset.

insights.claim: Stephen C. Neal, Chairman Emeritus of Cooley LLP and adviser to boards and special committees on governance, is Nvidia's Lead Independent Director and chairs its Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: A governance-litigation specialist in the lead independent role matters as Nvidia faces scrutiny.

insights.claim: Harvey Jones's compensation as Nvidia's newly established chairman has not been confirmed; the $363,809 figure reflects his pay before becoming chair.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Watch the next proxy for chair compensation disclosure.
insights.locator: What does Harvey C. Jones earn

insights.claim: Several Nvidia directors have very long tenures: Harvey Jones and Tench Coxe joined in 1993, Brooke Seawell in 1997, and Mark Stevens rejoined in 2008 after serving 1993-2006.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Long-tenured, founder-era boards can raise independence questions from governance-focused investors.

insights.claim: Nvidia's board is heavy with venture capital backgrounds (Sutter Hill, Sequoia, NEA, Square Wave) and EDA veterans, two of whom held senior Synopsys roles (Jones as CEO, Seawell as CFO).
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Board expertise skews to tech/VC, with consumer, pharma and finance executives added more recently.

insights.claim: Brooke Seawell, former Synopsys CFO and NEA Venture Partner, chairs Nvidia's Audit Committee; Dawn Hudson, former Pepsi-Cola North America CEO, chairs its Compensation Committee.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Identifies who owns audit and pay oversight at Nvidia during an investigation period.

insights.claim: Suzanne Nora Johnson, retired Goldman Sachs Vice Chairman and Pfizer audit chair, sits on Nvidia's Audit Committee and brings finance, risk and regulatory expertise.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Adds capital-markets and regulatory depth to Nvidia's audit oversight.

insights.claim: Nvidia's non-employee directors typically receive $363,809 per year according to its fiscal 2026 proxy statement.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.quote: NVIDIA's non-employee board members typically receive $363,809 per year

insights.claim: Jensen Huang received $36.34 million in total executive compensation for fiscal 2026.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: CEO pay reference point for governance and proxy analysis.

insights.claim: For long-serving Nvidia directors like Harvey Jones (since 1993), appreciation of retained stock awards likely far exceeds annual board pay, aligning them strongly with Nvidia's share price.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Directors' large accumulated equity may affect how independently they oversee management.
